editorial:
Imagine waking up in a strange city and finding out you have less than a day to live because someone poisoned you. That is exactly what happens to Kate, a deadly assassin who has to use her final hours to hunt down the people who betrayed her. The movie takes place in Tokyo, and the neon lights and busy streets give it a really cool, modern feel. You get to see Kate go from being a cold killing machine to someone who actually cares about others when she meets a young girl. It is a wild ride that feels like a race against the clock from start to finish.

What really makes this work is the fast action and the chemistry between the leads. The fight scenes are snappy and keep you on your toes, though some of the plot points are a bit simple. If you love movies where one person takes on an entire army, you will have a blast. For the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Netflix to see all those bright city colors pop. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for the high-quality picture.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Kate tracks down Varrick, the man who poisoned her. After a brutal fight, she kills him and gets her revenge. However, the poison finally wins, and she knows she is dying. Instead of fighting until the last second, she spends her final moments with the young girl she bonded with. She passes away peacefully, knowing she fixed her mistakes and left the girl in a safe place.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves John Wick or fast-paced revenge stories.
